# `unity install-modules` command reference

Generated from Unity CLI `1.0.0-beta.9` help output.

## unity install-modules

- CLI version: `1.0.0-beta.9`
- Supported platforms: linux, macos, windows
- Aliases: `im`

Install or list modules for an installed editor (fully interactive when no

arguments provided)

### Usage

`unity install-modules|im [options]`

### Subcommands

None.

### Positional arguments

None.

### Options

| Option | Value | Required | Repeatable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-e`, `--editor-version` | `<version>` | False | False | — | Version of the editor (interactive selection if omitted) |
| `-m`, `--module` | `<module...>` | False | False | — | Module IDs to install |
| `-l`, `--list` | — | False | False | — | List available modules for the editor |
| `--all` | — | False | False | — | Install all available modules |

| `--no-cm`, `--no-child-modules` | — | False | False | — | Do not install child modules automatically |
